mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM technician_assignment WHERE id = #{assignmentId} AND technician_id = #{profileId})

INSERT INTO request_image (id, move_request_id, storage_provider, object_key, original_filename, content_type, size_bytes, purpose, uploaded_by) SELECT #{imageId}, mr.id, 'LOCAL', #{objectKey}, #{filename}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, 'WORK_PROOF', #{userId} FROM technician_assignment ta JOIN reservation r ON r.id = ta.reservation_id JOIN move_request mr ON mr.id = r.move_request_id WHERE ta.id = #{assignmentId} AND ta.technician_id = #{profileId} RETURNING id, original_filename, content_type, size_bytes, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_event (id, assignment_id, event_type, note, evidence_image_id, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{assignmentId}, 'EVIDENCE_UPLOADED', '작업 증빙 이미지를 등록했습니다.', #{imageId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT image.id, image.original_filename, image.content_type, image.size_bytes, image.created_at FROM technician_assignment ta JOIN work_event event ON event.assignment_id = ta.id JOIN request_image image ON image.id = event.evidence_image_id WHERE ta.id = #{assignmentId} AND ta.technician_id = #{profileId} AND image.uploaded_by = #{userId} ORDER BY image.created_at

SELECT DISTINCT image.id, image.original_filename, image.content_type, image.size_bytes, image.created_at FROM technician_assignment ta JOIN work_event event ON event.assignment_id = ta.id JOIN request_image image ON image.id = event.evidence_image_id WHERE ta.id = #{assignmentId} AND image.purpose = 'WORK_PROOF' ORDER BY image.created_at
